entries.text: Heya! Step right up![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_first_00

entries.text: Kofu, the Surging Chef, here to deliver yer order![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_first_01

entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Fancy runnin’ into you again![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_00

entries.text: Yer still a student, ain’tcha? Yet here you are,\ngettin’ to invite special coaches and everything![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_01

entries.text: Yer really somethin’ else, kid![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_02

entries.text: Yep, I’m somethin’ else!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_select_01

entries.text: It’s not that big of a deal...
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_select_02

entries.text: Gahaha! You’ve got the confidence to match yer\nstrength, I see! What a great catch indeed![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_03

entries.text: Gahaha! What’s the point of denyin’ that a big\ndeal’s a big deal?! Bein’ humble only goes so\r\nfar, kid![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_03b

entries.text: Anyway, thanks for givin’ me the chance to come\nall the way out here![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_04

entries.text: Ol’ man Kofu’s gonna learn somethin’ along with\nthe kids, lemme tell ya![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp01_05

entries.text: This place is great, surrounded by the sea an’ all.\nCan’t imagine a better location![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_00

entries.text: Feelin’ the sea breeze puts a bit o’ spring in my\nstep—in my Pokémon’s, too![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_01

entries.text: That bein’ said, I couldn’t help but notice there’s\na lack of seafood on the cafeteria menu...[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_02

entries.text: Don’t ya think it’d make the students here happy\nif they could eat their fill of seafood, freshly\r\nbrought in from the ocean on their doorstep?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_03

entries.text: I bet they’d love it!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_select_01

entries.text: I think the menu’s fine as is...
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_select_02

entries.text: Excellent! Now that I got yer endorsement, it’s\ntime fer ol’ man Kofu to work his magic![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_04

entries.text: I can understand wantin’ junk food now an’ then,\nbut variety is the spice o’ life, as they say![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_04b

entries.text: Just you wait—the fingerlings here need a proper\nmeal, and Kofu Lounge is gonna provide it![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp02_05

entries.text: There ya are! I’ve got some news that’s sure to\nrock yer boat![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_00

entries.text: This ol’ man’s managed to land a collaboration\nbetween the Kofu Lounge and the Blueberry\r\nAcademy cafeteria![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_01

entries.text: That’s amazing!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_select_01

entries.text: I can’t wait!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_select_02

entries.text: ’Course, we only just settled on the deal. It’ll\ntake some time ’fore things really get goin’![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_02

entries.text: My first order o’ business is to rework the Kofu\nLounge’s House Special Hot Pot a bit—make it\r\nmore suited to the students here![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_03

entries.text: Growin’ kids deserve the best food, after all![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_04

entries.text: Heh—lookit ol’ Kofu. I was just doin’ what came\nnaturally, and now here I am teachin’ nutrition![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_sp03_05

entries.text: What a catch! Thanks to yer callin’ me here, I get\nto learn alongside the kids![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_00

entries.text: I’m in your debt, kid! Gahaha![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_01

entries.text: Whaddya say we go with the flow and trade\nPokémon while we’re here, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_02

entries.text: Gahaha! Well, I’ll be lettin’ loose my Veluza!\nHow ’bout you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_03

entries.text: A lively [VAR 0x0101(0001)]! What a great catch!\c\nDon’t you worry—this ol’ man’s gonna take real\ngood care of this darlin’![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You wanna trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for my\nVeluza?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Kofu a Pokémon if you aren’t its\noriginal Trainer!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Kofu such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Kofu a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Hold it, kid! Ya can’t trade if you’ve only got one
Pokémon with ya!\c
Better go get at least two on yer team ’fore you
try a trade![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_03_00

entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Didn’t expect you to say no![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_03_01

entries.text: Are ya gonna trade Pokémon with this ol’ man\nafter all?![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_trade_04_00

entries.text: Step right up!\c\nWhy not have a lively battle with ol’ man Kofu?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_talkto_00

entries.text: Aw, that’s too bad...\n*sniffle*[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_cancel_00

entries.text: I’ve caught myself a whopper! Let’s head on up\nto the entrance, then![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 58]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: There’s no stoppin’ the force you muster! It’s like\nwatchin’ a Magikarp swim up a waterfall![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: Facin’ young’uns like yerself helps this ol’ man\nlearn and grow, too![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: Here’s a little somethin’ for ya! Its spice packs a\nreal wallop—jus’ like you, kid![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: You come back to see me again now, ya hear?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 58]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Seems like I was the one reeled\nin this time![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: Ol’ man Kofu’s always ready for the next battle!\nLookin’ forward to it, in fact![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: I am Kofu the Torrent! Ever changin’—just like\nwater! And you can’t even fathom my depths\r\njust yet! Gahahahaha![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: I LOVE the colors here at Blueberry Academy!\nSuch clear blues—just like Cascarrafa![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_00

entries.text: Didja see those li’l flowers bloomin’ in the\nTerarium? Such precious things, doin’ their\r\nabsolute darndest![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
Lemme tell ya, gettin’ a chance to work with
students has been a real learnin’ experience!\c
You’ve got no idea how many cool new poses
I’ve picked up! What a haul![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you traded me is fresh an’
lively!
I
can’t
wait to see what it’s got in store
fer me![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_03

entries.text: That Veluza I let loose on ya has got a real\nsharpness to her! Better watch out, though—\r\nsometimes she’ll go and self-serve sashimi![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
Gahaha! Geeta spilled the beans, y’know!\c
So you chose ol’ man Kofu as your favorite
Gym Leader, eh? That was a flash flood o’ joy,
lemme tell ya.\c
Don’tcha worry, kid—yer a dear friend o’
mine, too![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mizu_randomtalk_sp
